payload.name: Count events by target date with content-date fallback
payload.description: Use when a question asks how many events of a type occurred for a subject by a target date and searches may filter out memories whose world_start is after the target date.
content: When answering a count-as-of-date question, do not rely only on world_start filters; run at least one search with time_mode='none' (or a wide window) to find memories whose content may state the actual event date.

For each retrieved memory, resolve the event date from the content if it mentions one (e.g., 'on July 8, 2022', 'last week'), and count the event only if that content date is on or before the target date.

If a memory states an ordinal count (e.g., 'won his fourth tournament') but its world_start is after the target date, still include it when the content confirms the event happened before the target date; inspect all versions for the latest update.
Stop after one additional search without a time filter returns no new distinct event memories with content dates on or before the target date.

solves: Questions asking for a count of events by a target date can be answered incorrectly when a memory's world_start metadata is set to a later date (e.g., recording time) while the event date appears only in the content. Time-filtered searches then miss the decisive memory. This skill ensures retrieval includes content-embedded event dates and counts them correctly.
